title: Pin fin convection
line: A steady thermal FEA study of an aluminum pin fin with its base at 80 C, cooled by air.
description: Steady heat flow through an aluminum pin fin, 6 mm in diameter and 50 mm long. The base is held at 80 C and the side and tip lose heat to 25 C air at 25 W/m^2/K. The study returns the temperature along the fin, the heat flowing in through the base and the tip temperature, which the classical fin solution predicts.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature falling along an aluminum pin fin from its 80 C base, solved in RunMat
